results.title: SAMPADA data claims lower anaemia prevalence in India than previous surveys
results.content: India stopped collecting anaemia data as part of NFHS, after the 5th round. This is the first time anaemia data is being published, after the measure was withdrawn from the NFHS on the grounds that the government intended to conduct a gold-standard test of drawing venous blood, instead of the finger prick test
